title: September 28 to October 4, 2026
summary: Set 14 is fully revealed, cards gain their Epic, Enchanted and Iconic printings, Ink Drops becomes a playstyle and the homepage gets faster.

new.title: Set 14 fully revealed
new.body: The Reveals page held 181 of the set's 204 main cards on September 30 and all 204 on October 1, every one officially revealed. The leaked card taken down the week before returned on September 30, after its official reveal, and cards first published from a foreign-language scan switched to their English printing.

new.title: Epic, Enchanted and Iconic printings
new.body: Cards with an alternate printing now have a printing switcher and a swipeable art strip, on the card page and in the card window. Sets 9 to 13 gained 190 printings, and Set 14 its first two Iconics.

new.title: Alt arts on the Reveals page
new.body: Each ink's board now has a row for its Epic, Enchanted and Iconic printings, and clicking a revealed one opens the card on that printing. By October 4 the rows held 13 of the 18 Epics, 11 of the 18 Enchanteds and two Iconics.

new.title: See translation
new.body: Set 14 cards whose only scan so far is in another language can show their English name and rules text over the art, marked as an unofficial translation. 18 cards had it at the end of September.

improved.title: A faster homepage
improved.body: The homepage's main script is about half the size it was, featured cards appear without waiting for the full card database, and the logo paints straight away without shifting the layout. Repeat visits reuse cached files, and text no longer jumps when the web font arrives.

improved.title: Reduced motion
improved.body: The card image fade-in now switches off when your device asks for reduced motion.

improved.title: Easier-to-read card text
improved.body: Ability names are now bold, with a little more space before the effect.

improved.title: Search box
improved.body: The homepage search's focus ring now matches the header search, in the brand gold.

improved.title: Steadier card pages
improved.body: Card pages no longer jump while they load: the footer now waits until the card and its synergies are in, instead of being pushed down as they arrive.

fixed.title: Mobile card pages
fixed.body: Card pages with many synergy groups no longer scroll sideways on phones.

fixed.title: Card search
fixed.body: Search now finds names typed with a curly apostrophe, the way iPhones type it, so bruno’s finds Bruno's Return.

fixed.title: Mobile search focus
fixed.body: Closing search on a phone now returns keyboard focus to the Search tab.

fixed.title: Stuck old versions
fixed.body: Devices still running an old copy of the site from www.inkweave.ink now clear it and move to inkweave.ink.

fixed.title: Printing switcher fixes
fixed.body: On a phone, closing a card page opened through a redirected comparison link now goes to Browse instead of leaving the site, and switching a comparison's Engine and Community tabs no longer scrolls the page.

fixed.title: Reveals page on phones
fixed.body: The ink board's header glow now spans the whole panel.

fixed.title: Card text
fixed.body: Kit Cloudkicker - Sure Shot now shows the ink symbol in its rules text.

engine.title: New playstyle: Ink Drops
engine.body: Set 14's new mechanic gets its own playstyle, pairing cards that create ink drops with cards that spend, hold or convert them. Baloo - Delivery Pilot, who can't quest or challenge unless you gained an ink drop that turn, finds his partners too, and keeps them on his English printing.

engine.title: Set 14 audit corrections
engine.body: Wrong scores were fixed across Self-Discard, Items, Super, Location Control and Bounce, and Honey Lemon - Endlessly Curious regained its Ramp synergies.

engine.title: Card text the engine can read
engine.body: Curly apostrophes no longer hide synergies, and new reveals are written with the game's symbols before they're published, so they don't lose mechanics to spelled-out words.

behindTheScenes: Plus 32 behind-the-scenes changes: dependency updates, deploy and tooling fixes, tests, docs and work on features that aren't switched on yet.
